name: ShortlistIQ
summary: AI recruiting assistant that runs first-round candidate interviews in chat, in a tone and persona you set, and returns a scoring report for each applicant; plans are metered by invited applicants per month.
best_for: small and mid-size teams and recruitment agencies that get more applicants than they can screen and want an AI to run the first-round interview and score each candidate
skip_if: you need a full applicant tracking system; you hire only a few people a year and screen them yourself; or you hire where automated screening needs a level of human review or disclosure you cannot set up
honest_knock: No yearly prices are shown although the FAQ mentions yearly plans, and the cards do not name their currency. Basic covers only 20 applicants a month with a single AI assistant. Unused or partly used service is not refunded on early cancellation, and the homepage selling point, that candidates cannot tell the AI from a person, puts the duty to disclose on you.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · labelled per month, up to 20 invited applicants a month, one AI assistant, unlimited job positions
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-16 in a browser on shortlistiq.com/pricing; the cards show a $ sign without naming the currency, and clicking Pay annually did not change the amounts) Three paid plans, each labelled per month and metered by invited applicants per month: Basic $49 for up to 20 applicants and one AI assistant; Standard $199 for up to 200 applicants and unlimited AI assistants with live chat support; Premium $599 for up to 2,000 applicants with a dedicated account manager and personalised onboarding. All paid plans list unlimited job positions and no setup fees. Every account starts on a free plan for up to 10 applicants, with no credit card. The FAQ mentions monthly and yearly plans that can be cancelled at any time, but no yearly price is shown. Payments run through Lemon Squeezy as merchant of record; the terms say there are no refunds or credits for partly used or unused service on early cancellation, except where the law requires them.

compare_with.name: Breezy HR
compare_with.why: Breezy HR is in our dossiers too, but it is an applicant tracking system: job posting, pipeline and candidate management, with a free plan for one open position and Startup at $157 a month billed annually when we read it on 27 September 2026. ShortlistIQ does not replace an ATS; it adds an AI that interviews and scores applicants in the first round.
